source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Importance of Data Visualization' under topic 7.5 (PDF 100-101, printed 96-97).

blocks.text: Data visualization is liye zaroori hai ke yeh kache (raw) data ko ba-maani tasveeri shaklon mein badal deti hai. Is se researchers bare datasets jaldi samajh lete hain jinhein sirf numbers se samajhna mushkil hota. Visual tools data ke trends, distributions (phailao) aur farq wazeh dikhate hain, aur nataij ko technical aur non-technical dono qism ke logon tak pohanchana aasan banate hain. Ghair-mamooli patterns nazar aane se ghaltiyan bhi kam hoti hain. Yeh statistics ke nataij ko behtar samajhne mein madad deti hai, is liye data analysis aur hypothesis testing mein yeh zaroori qadam hai.
